firmware.title: SpeccyP
firmware.author: billgilbert7000, AlexEkb
firmware.description: A ZX Spectrum 48K, Pentagon 128/512/1024, Scorpion and Navigator with AY, TurboSound and Betadisk. Loads TAP, TZX, TRD.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard, gamepad as Kempston. F11: files, F12: settings, F1: help.
